ratings.comment: Alyssa is engaging, hilarious, and cares about her students. The exams are very easy. Lecture is a touch disorganized, with more reading/videos than are necessary. Unfortunately for Alyssa, the support staff managing CTEN and skills check offs leave much to be desired. Prepare extra hard for check offs, they will fail you for anything.

Prof Haure is easily the best professor the school of nursing has to offer. She also taught pathophysiology and if you show up to class, pay attention, ask questions, and study a little bit, you'll do just fine in her course. She is very kind and funny. I wish she could teach every course in the program.

Professor Alyssa taught Nursing313 in a easy to understand manner even though the coursework itself was tough. She made the material enjoyable and was very interactive and helpful if you ever needed help.
Pay attention in lectures especially to things she emphases more then once! She's incredibly knowledgeable and will help you if you ask for it!

No nonsense instructor, which in my opinion is incredible. She is getting students ready for the real world of nursing. Don't make excuses, pay attention, follow through with actions and you will be just fine in her class. The only people that ever complain are those that don't study, don't pay attention, and don't do what's required.

Overall really great professor that does an amazing job combining her clinical practice experience with lecture. I wish we would have had more time with her as the nursing fundamentals class we had with her was half a semester. I would suggest giving her more time as what she has to say is very valuable.
